headline: Nasdaq 100 Rallies, Intel Soars 14%: Stock Market Today
summary: A fourth straight decline in crude oil handed Wall Street a fresh leg higher Monday, with the Nasdaq 100 jumping to a three-month high as semiconductors led the tape. Intel surged nearly 14% on SK Hynix foundry optimism while AMD crossed the $1 trillion mark. Energy was the lone sector in the red as WTI slid more than 5% to an 11-day low
